comment: Compute Crafter's Process page config, and its maps file too (docs.maps names it): Git Crafter templates/process/config.json at v7.0.2. Its maps are the library maps whose steps sit on this repo's Quality tabs (delivery, triage, contribute, adopt, measure, code, secure, document) and the Spend map, maps/spend.json, with all 5 steps. Left out: board (4 of 6 steps score on the Projects tab, which this repo drops: no Project board) and deploy (all 4 steps score on the Pages tab, dropped: no site but this page). Dropped steps: triage card (projects.latest_cycle_hours) and contribute deploy (deploy.failure_rate_last10). A Spend step whose metric needs local files shows not measured in CI. tests/pack.test.mjs checks the Spend map agrees with maps/spend.json. Keys: Git Crafter actions/pages/action.yml; maps: pages/maps/README.md.

maps.name: Spend
maps.why: Compute Crafter's compute and credits, from free allowances first to idle capacity dropped
maps.ideal: Use free and included allowances before anything that bills, read their use the same day, and never idle free capacity in a lane over budget.

sources.title: REST API endpoints for billing usage

steps.name: Re-read
steps.rule: Re-read each free-tier figure on its provider's own page, and record the date.

steps.name: Free first
steps.rule: Claim every free allowance before anything that bills.

steps.name: Read
steps.rule: Each allowance's use is read the same day.

steps.name: Stay under
steps.rule: CI stays under the included minutes; no overage, no larger runners.
gates: Spend past the included amount waits for the owner's yes (Git Crafter rules/compute.md)

steps.name: Drop idle
steps.rule: Free capacity in a lane over budget never sits idle; swap in a cheaper lane.
